title: WPT license text (data/license-texts/<id>/license-text.json): one license text (a license file, a notice, a README) and its decision (docs/licenses.md). <id> is the sha256 of its normalized text: its first 200,000 bytes read as UTF-8, lowercased, without the lines naming a copyright, then every run of characters other than a-z and 0-9 made one space, trimmed (wpt_dataset.license_check.text_id). license-text.txt beside it, when there, holds the text itself

decision.description: whether the text is an accepted license statement, signed by a person: a file trains only when its source, its license entry and the text found at its entry's place are all admitted

kind.description: license: the text of a license (`license` names it when it is a known one); notice: it names a license without its text; not-a-license: it grants nothing (a guideline, a pointer to another file); readme: a README, read for what it says about training

license.description: the SPDX expression of the license it is or names; an OR of the ids a text is equally the text of (GPL-3.0-only OR GPL-3.0-or-later)

found.description: where it was first found, when known

path.description: the file's path in that source, or the address of the license page it was found at

files.description: the sha256 of each exact file it was seen as: a file is found by its own sha256 first, then by its normalized text

explanation.description: why the decision, in the reviewer's words

by.description: a person's name; under review only, a machine's (machine:<host>)

reason.description: required to refuse; optional under review
